image_keywords: The Law will never be perfect
summary: This diagram visualizes the behavior of attention heads in a neural network, specifically related to sentence structure. It shows two examples of how different attention heads from the encoder self-attention layer connect words in a sentence. The sentences 'The Law will never be perfect, but its application should be just' and 'this is what we are missing, in my opinion' are used to illustrate the connections. The lines represent the attention weights, with varying thickness indicating the strength of the connection between words. This visualization helps in understanding how attention mechanisms focus on different parts of a sentence to capture contextual relationships.
